rv.q: Marriott starts the baseball season with the right show and it hits a grand slam.
With a strong cast, charmingly athletic choreography and dynamic staging, this “Damn Yankees” has an OBP that would make Bill James blush.
It’s wonderful to see “Damn Yankees” revived in such a definitive production.
This production is a home run hit in every way.

All these merge in “Damn Yankees,” the 1955 award-winning hit with book by George Abbott and Douglass Wallop, lyrics and music by Richard Adler and Jerry Ross, choreography by Bob Fosse and starring Ray Walston and Gwen Verdon.
Marriott Theatre's new production of Damn Yankees is pitch-perfect.
You might consider selling your soul for this level of entertainment, but you don't have to: tickets for Damn Yankees are available from Marriott Theatre and at 888-729-4718 .
Marriot Theatre, known for its outstanding productions, hits it out of the park with DAMN YANKEES.
Damn Yankees otherwise holds up surprisingly well and this production is worthy of flying the W flag.
If you haven't seen a production for 30 years or so, make it a point to get to Lincolnshire for this sterling production.

The choreography and dancers in Marriott Theatre’s “Damn Yankees” were so amazing opening night (April 19, 2023) I could have sworn that Rachel Rockwell, an extraordinary director and choreographer who died in 2018, had somehow returned.
You will surely enjoy this fun, joyful, foot-stomping, exuberant, high-energy, exhilarating production.

cn.t: Marriott's production of this classic 1955 musical wins rave reviews for its stellar choreography, strong vocals, and witty humor. Critics praise the pitch-perfect direction and performances in this devilishly fun revival.
